system.description: This bullet identifies a smartlink-tagged target and uses nanosensors and telemetry from previous bullets to lock on, correcting the bullet’s trajectory with surface alterations and tiny vectored nozzles. Apply a +10 modifier to hit for attacks following an aim action (cumulative with the aim modifier) or previous attacks against the same target. Homing bullets can also be used for indirect fire ▶206, though without the to-hit modifier.
